title: Android 17 QPR2 greatly expands Dynamic Color theming on Pixel
summary: With Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3’s surprise Friday drop, Google is introducing expanded Dynamic Color theming options for Pixel devices. The paint palette icon above the carousel lets you access a “Select a color” slider to choose the main accent.
